title: Answer: experience at a time is fixed by the present state

statements.text: Experience at time $t$ is fixed by the complete present physical state of the conscious system, $C_t = f(X_t)$, and not by how the system got there. Which property of that state constitutes experience, and whether it is basic or derived, the paper leaves open.

sources.quote: Under local state sufficiency and causal efficacy, consciousness must supervene on the complete present physical state of the local system
